properties.statement:
A CONSUMER DESIGN HIT THE CORROBORATION GAP, 2026-08-31, WHICH BEARS DIRECTLY ON THE MEASUREMENT THAT RE-RANKED THAT DECISION'S OPTIONS.

═══ WHAT THE DECISION CONCLUDED, AND ON WHAT ═══
`dec:idea-how-should-one-finding-say-it-corroborates-another` was re-ranked on 2026-08-16 by a measurement across every committed export on this machine — dev_storyflow, dynograph-foundation, flo2, music_graph, quantum_benchmarking_initiative, storyflow: **ZERO TemporalFacts in all six.** Its conclusion: "THIS IS A SELF-HOST-ONLY PATTERN... reflow2 is the only project recording its own defects as TemporalFacts." That argued options (c) and (d) would pay a CONSUMER cost — a moved stamp, an upgrade doc, older binaries refusing newer graphs — for a relation no consumer uses, and favoured (e), fixing the discoverability of `alignment: supporting`.

═══ 🛑 WHAT bhome SHOWS, AND WHY THE MEASUREMENT DOES NOT COVER IT ═══
`proj:bhome` is a CONSUMER design — a transportable pod dwelling, nothing to do with reflow2 — and its agent hit the gap in its `brainstorm` pass. Its words: "There is no honest 'reinforces' relation... I dropped a true positive link (the mushroom loop reinforces the self-sustaining requirement by eating a waste stream nothing else eats) rather than write a misleading-looking edge. A first-class SUPPORTS / REINFORCES would have captured it."

⭐⭐ THE PAIRING IS THE POINT: THIS IS NOT FACT→FACT. It is an exploratory Decision supporting a Requirement — an idea reinforcing intent. The 2026-08-16 sweep asked whether any consumer design had **fact→fact** corroboration and correctly answered no, because consumers do not record their own defects as TemporalFacts. IT DID NOT AND COULD NOT ASK whether consumers need to express corroboration between OTHER node types, and that shape is available to every design reflow2 serves, not only to the self-host.

⇒ SO "SELF-HOST-ONLY" IS TRUE OF THE PATTERN THAT WAS MEASURED AND NOT OF THE NEED. The decision's own stated bound anticipated something like this — "it would take only one consumer starting to record findings to overturn it" — though the overturn arrived from a direction it did not name: a different type pairing rather than a consumer adopting TemporalFacts.

═══ ⚠️ WHAT THIS DOES AND DOES NOT DO TO THE OPTIONS ═══
It WEAKENS the strongest argument against (c)/(d) — that they charge consumers for a self-host habit — without establishing that either is worth its stamp cost. It does NOT weaken option (e): the observed failure here is still an author not finding a mechanism that exists, and bhome's agent explicitly knew `alignment: supporting` existed and rejected it on READABILITY grounds ("an edge that renders as CONTRADICTS when it means 'supports' reads wrong to any human skimming edge types later"), which is a different complaint from not finding it. (e) fixes discoverability; it does not fix a reader's experience of the rendered edge.

🛑 AND THE COST IS NOW OBSERVED RATHER THAN HYPOTHESISED: a true relation was NOT RECORDED. The decision previously described the cost as "a word that says the opposite of its meaning, and an author who must find a property to negate the type they just chose" — an ergonomics complaint. bhome shows it also silently loses edges, which is the failure the whole linking discipline exists to prevent.

⚠️ BOUNDS. One design, one agent, one dropped edge — self-reported and not independently verified. The agent is an LLM session rather than a human user, and it may be applying reflow2's own doctrine about edge readability more strictly than a consumer would. n=1 for the consumer claim, against n=6 for the sweep it qualifies.
